verdict.rationale: DeepSeek is an API platform, so a downloadable machine-readable spec is a fair question. The evidence only shows compatibility with the OpenAI and Anthropic API formats, plus guides on streaming, function calling and rate limits. None of it documents a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent spec. Format compatibility, which would let a user rely on another vendor's spec, is adjacent and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
